summary: Creates a skill for filling HWPX (Hancom Hangul) document templates with data. The trace shows a working pattern: HWPX files are ZIP archives with XML content, placeholders use {{key}} syntax, and layout-cache elements (linesegarray) must be removed from modified paragraphs to prevent rendering issues.

The task succeeded using the existing skill. Minor improvements: clarify when to use the script vs inline code, add verification for multiple section files, and note that removing all linesegarray is acceptable for simple templates.

The task completed the HWPX filling correctly but the verifier failed, suggesting the skill's verification guidance may be incomplete. Updates include: (1) fixing the inline Python example to preserve all archive files, (2) adding explicit verification that all original files are preserved, (3) adding a troubleshooting section for cases where basic verification passes but output may still be incorrect.

The existing hwpx-template-filling skill worked well, but the task revealed a gap: the agent needed to perform data transformations (calculating month spans, normalizing budget format) beyond simple placeholder replacement. The skill should clarify when to use the provided script vs inline Python, and document common transformation patterns.

The existing hwpx-template-filling skill already covers the core workflow well. Adding Korean-specific transformation patterns (number suffix removal, rating format conversion) that are common in HWPX documents but were not documented. These patterns follow the same inline Python approach the skill already recommends for transformations.

The task succeeded using the existing skill with inline Python for transformations. Adding common transformation patterns (date format conversion, value-dependent suffixes, multi-source data merging) to the skill will help future agents implement these recurring needs faster.

The trace shows successful use of the existing skill with patterns not fully documented: direct text replacement (without {{placeholder}} syntax), CSV data sources, and selective paragraph replacement. Adding these patterns to SKILL.md improves coverage for real-world HWPX editing tasks.

The trace shows a successful execution of the existing hwpx-template-filling skill with straightforward placeholder replacement. The agent correctly chose inline Python over the script, preserved archive structure, removed linesegarray, and performed comprehensive verification. All patterns used are already documented in the existing SKILL.md. No new failure modes, anti-patterns, or missing guidance were identified that would benefit future runs.
